text: わたしも　ポケモンを　そだててるの！

structure.jp: わたしも　ポケモンを　そだててるの！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, for something ongoing. そだててる = 'am raising'.

patterns.name: 〜の (sentence ending)
patterns.explanation: の at the end softly explains or states something in a friendly way. そだててるの = 'I'm raising (them), you know'.
